definitions.short: Mattanjah , the name of ten Israelites
definitions.full: H4983. Mattanyah or Mattanyahu מַתַּנְיָה מַתַּנְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine (compare Gray Prop. N. 294, No. 82 ); — ᵐ5 Μαθθας , Μανθανιας , Ματθανιας , etc.; — 1 מַתַּנְיָה , last king of Judah, name changed to Zedekiah 2Kin 24:17 . 2 מַתַּנְיָ֫הוּ , Levite name: a. son of Heman 1Chr 25:4 . b. Asaphite 1Chr 25:16 . c. id. , 2Chr 29:13 (Hezekiah's time). 3 מַתַּנְיָה , Levite name: a. Asaphite 1Chr 9:15 ; Neh 11:17 , 22 ; 12:8 , 35 , perhaps = 2b, c (but much confusion and uncertainty; e.g. ׳מ is of Hezekiah's time 2Chr 29:13 , and 4th Generation before Nehemiah, Neh 11:12 ; 12:35 ; while contemporary of Zerubbabel 12:8 and of Nehemiah 11:17 ). b. other Levites: (1) 2Chr 20:14 , (2) Neh 12:25 , (3) 13:13 . 4 מַתַּנְיָה , name of several who took strange wives: a. Ezra 10:26 . b. Ezra 10:27 . c. Ezra 10:30 . d. Ezra 10:37 .
definitions.rootNote: or מַתַּנְיָהוּ ; from 4976 and 3050 ; gift of Jah ;
